events.title: Flick Demo is LIVE!
events.summary: After months of grinding, playtesting, and jumping from one bug to another, it's finally time to release...💀THE FLICK DEMO💀This demo consists of the first three rooms of the main game (minus a few key story elements) and generally takes between 15-20 minutes to complete. If you dig what you play here, tell your friends and don't forget to wishlist!A million and one thanks to everyone who playtested this experience and gave amazing feedback. events.title: Flick Playtest NOW LIVE
events.summary: Finally!Wow. It's been a long time coming, but we finally made it! There have been some ups and some downs (as with all things game dev related), but the release of this playtest marks an important stepping stone in the lifetime of this game. A little about the playtest....I wanted to create a short experience that would really give players a good sense of the style of horror game that I'm going for.
